text:
sam_support: FYI Acme filed an escalation — Console 1h TTFT/tokens/sec chart showing intermittent negative values and weird drops since ~03:40 UTC. They attached a screenshot and say the raw streaming logs look normal. Can SRE triage? https://acme.inc/snap.png :eyes:
maria_customer: they pointed out it's only on the rolled-up 1h window, the per-second stream looks OK (positive). Happens across multiple models and regions for them.
emily_sre: thanks, can you paste the grafana query + timeframe? have them run the raw promql too. My hunch: something in the metrics exporter/rollup path is flipping a counter into a gauge or losing label cardinality during eviction, which yields negative deltas on rollups.
jordan_prod: try this quick check to spot negative deltas:
```
# look for decreases in the counter between samples
increase(stream_tokens_total[5m]) < 0
# or compute raw rate and inspect windows
rate(stream_tokens_total[1m])
```
sam_support: sending query + repro steps from Acme: they say to reproduce: 1) heavy short bursts via the SDK for 30m 2) restart edge-proxy with METRICS_EVICT_SECONDS=300 3) watch 1h dashboard after 10m. Also pasted exporter logs showing an eviction event: `[2026-03-12T03:47:12Z] metrics: evicted 24 series due to ttl` and later a decrease logged: `stream_tokens_total{region="us-west",model="gpt-xx"} 124567` then `0` within same bucket.
metrics-bot: alert muted: support/console-negative-ttft (suppressed duplicate).
emily_sre: I spun up a quick repro locally following their steps and I can reproduce the sign flip on the 1h rollup. Root cause looks like: when the exporter evicts series we end up shipping a sample with the old series absent and aggregator code treats missing series as zero for the bucket, causing a negative delta when the next sample reappears. In short: TTL eviction + aggregator rollup semantics -> negative increases.
jordan_prod: probable fixes: 1) change aggregator to clamp increases to >=0 at rollup time, 2) treat evicted series as absent (skip) instead of zero for delta computation, 3) update exporter to emit a final zero/sample marker instead of silently dropping.
sam_support: mitigation for Acme: switch the 1h chart to use `max(0, increase(stream_tokens_total[1h]))` temporarily and set rollup to 5m windows for now. I've communicated that to them.
emily_sre: filing ENG-RUNTIME ticket and tagging @jordan_prod. Created RT ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RT-3491 assigned to eng-runtime. I'll add repro steps and logs.
sam_support: thanks everyone, customer updated that clamping query removed negative spikes in the dashboard. Leaving open until a runtime patch lands. :thumbsup:
